ledger.x: c. 1580: the Seventeenth Dynasty rules from Thebes. Infobox 'Established: c. 1580 BC', 'Capital: Thebes'; 'ruled in Upper Egypt during the late Second Intermediate Period'. The page names no land beyond Upper Egypt; the Elephantine-to-Cusae shape is Kamose's time. [Reviewer me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Year set…

c. 1553: Kamose sails north against the Hyksos. 'In Kamose's third year, he embarked on his military campaign against the Hyksos by sailing north out of Thebes'; 'He first reached Nefrusy, which was just north of Cusae' (1555-1550 reign: year 3 = 1553). The page holds that Kamose probably never attacked Avaris.…

c. 1550: Kamose dies and Ahmose I takes over the war. Infobox 'Died: 1550 BC'; Ahmose 'made the final conquest of them and united all of Egypt'. [Author fix me-03-b, 2026-10-18] Zone moved from Asyut 80 km (reached Sohag, south of Cusae) to lon 30.82, lat 27.6, 60 km between Cusae and Hermopolis, the same circle as…

c. 1550: the Seventeenth Dynasty ends and Ahmose I founds the Eighteenth. Infobox 'Disestablished: c. 1550 BC', 'Succeeded by Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt'; Kamose 'last king of the Seventeenth Dynasty' (1555-1550). The page's narrative says the war was 'Beginning The New Kingdom of Egypt'.

wars.name: Seqenenre Tao's attack on the Hyksos
wars.outcome: Seqenenre Tao 'was killed in the battle' of the first wave of attacks 'toward the southern flank'; no land changed hands.

wars.name: Kamose's Nubian campaigns
wars.outcome: No result stated: 'Kamose is known to have campaigned against the Kushites prior to his third year'; a second campaign 'in his Year 4 or 5', whose target 'may have been the fortress at Buhen'.

wars.name: Ahmose I's reconquest of Egypt from the Hyksos
wars.outcome: Kamose's sortie to Nefrusy (year 3) opens the war that Ahmose I wins at Avaris and Sharuhen.

certainty.note: Only the Elephantine and Cusae limits are named, for Kamose's time; the rest is approximate.
